vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: keel requires golang.org/x/crypto but never imports golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; the package is absent from vendor/modules.txt and from every keel binary. govulncheck reports it at module level only, with no call path.
